capabilities: Apply a Munpia-style typesetting to notes
Apply a Novelpia-style typesetting to notes
extras: README is bilingual (Korean and English) and very short; the author says other platform styles can be added on request, so the plugin may grow beyond the two current styles.
problem: Obsidian on PC has no built-in way to display notes with the mobile-style typesetting used by Korean web novel sites.
summary: Style plugin that renders notes on desktop in the look of the Korean web novel platforms Munpia and Novelpia.
